verdict.rationale: The pack documents an AR aging report by customer, but nothing documents an accounts payable aging report or point-in-time vendor balances. The AR aging evidence covers receivables, a different story, and does not transfer. The MCP tool list mentions bills and vendors, but it is a data-access surface rather than a documented AP aging or vendor-balance view, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
